title: Drizz's AI App Testing Ambition Meets Reality
script:
Drizz built an AI agent designed to test mobile applications autonomously.
The system navigates user interfaces just like a human tester would do.
Analytics India Magazine analyzed how these automated tools face unexpected real world friction.
Complex layouts and dynamic elements often break the execution flow entirely.
Engineering teams still need to supervise edge cases during software validation runs.
Can autonomous agents replace human software testers anytime soon?
